clue.text: Many going by water are boastful

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, which crosswords read as many
rowing is travelling by boat with oars

explanation.surface: A crowd of people out on the river is accused of showing off.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone crowing is gloating loudly, bragging about a success.

clue.text: Reticent persona a hard worker yet noisy

parts.note: a clam is a person who keeps quiet, as in clamming up
the ant is proverbially industrious

explanation.surface: A quiet person who works hard is nonetheless loud.
explanation.definitionFit: Clamant means clamorous, insistently loud.

clue.text: Give offence, though not in a bad mood

parts.note: out means not at home, not in
rage is a fit of violent anger

explanation.surface: Someone causes offence without being angry.
explanation.definitionFit: To outrage people is to shock and anger them, the verb meaning to offend.

clue.text: It may contain prison uprising that's pointless

indicators.note: may contain has the word it hold another piece inside
in a down clue an uprising reads the word from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure, a slang word for a prison

explanation.surface: A jail riot achieved nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'uprising' means read upwards; 'may contain' is the container signal, with 'It' doing double surface duty as a pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: Inept means clumsy and ineffective, so its efforts are futile.

clue.text: Warmer, like the man in great shape

indicators.note: in puts the pieces before it inside the reshaped letters
shape signals that the letters of the word great are reformed

parts.note: as means like, in the same way
he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A man in fine form is comparable to a heater.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shape' is the anagram signal on 'great', and 'in' is the container signal; 'Warmer' looks like a comparative adjective but is a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A gas-fired room heater is a domestic appliance that warms.

clue.text: The pirate company's grabbing right music

indicators.note: grabbing has one piece take hold of another, so it sits inside

parts.note: CO is the usual abbreviation for company, and the possessive adds S
an air is a tune, a piece of music

explanation.surface: A pirate crew seizes the rights to a song.
explanation.definitionFit: A corsair is a privateer or sea raider, especially of the Barbary coast.

clue.text: A number relax at top

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a number
to rest is to relax

explanation.surface: Someone takes a break at the summit.
explanation.definitionFit: A crest is the summit of a hill or wave.

clue.text: Don't forget about hoard!

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to collect is to amass or hoard things

explanation.surface: A reminder to keep a stockpile in mind.
explanation.definitionFit: To recollect is to remember, the opposite of forgetting.

clue.text: A guy one thanks for this being a rapid grower

parts.note: a guy is a man
I is the Roman numeral for one
ta is a British informal word for thanks

explanation.surface: A man gives thanks for something that grows quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: Amanita is a genus of mushrooms, fungi known for appearing quickly.

clue.text: Standing up to hold forth about a politician

indicators.note: about has one piece go around the others

parts.note: to rant is to hold forth loudly
MP stands for Member of Parliament, a politician

explanation.surface: A politician stands up to make a speech.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry a rampant beast is rearing on its hind legs.

clue.text: Bill needs long hair as a thespian

parts.note: AC is short for account, and an account is a bill
a tress is a long lock of hair

explanation.surface: Someone is told to grow their hair long to play a part on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A thespian is a stage performer, and a female one is so called.

clue.text: Call no more to make demands

parts.note: ex means former, something that is no more
to claim is to demand something as one's due

explanation.surface: A protester is told to stop shouting their demands.
explanation.definitionFit: To exclaim is to cry out, a synonym for call.

clue.text: Meant to negotiate about some accommodation

indicators.note: about has one piece placed around another
negotiating works the letters round into a new deal, so this word is rearranged

parts.note: part means some of something

explanation.surface: Someone intends to haggle over a share of the housing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to negotiate' is the anagram signal on 'Meant', and 'about' is the container signal; 'some' supplies the piece placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat or set of rooms to live in is a form of accommodation.

clue.text: Money, that is returns, the French woman's made

parts.note: L stands for pound, the British unit of money (from libra)

indicators.note: returns means the abbreviation is turned round and read backwards

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is
la is the French feminine word for the

explanation.surface: A woman makes money, so to speak, out of French returns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns IE into EI. 'Woman's made' means the woman is formed from these pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Leila is a girl's given name, so it names a woman.

clue.text: Some loathe taking a letter

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people hate receiving a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Theta is the eighth character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: She daren't upset fans

indicators.note: upset signals the letters of the words before it are overturned and jumbled

explanation.surface: A woman is afraid of annoying her supporters.
explanation.definitionFit: Adherents are followers or supporters of a cause or person.

clue.text: Where the footwear manufacturer goes without a break

explanation.surface: A shoemaker works on without stopping.
explanation.walkthrough: A last is the foot-shaped block a cobbler shapes shoes on; the proverb tells the cobbler to stick to it.
explanation.definitionFit: A cobbler heads for the shoe-shaping block; the phrase also means right until the end, with no pause.

clue.text: Dealing with those having some complaint?

definitions.text: Dealing with those having some complaint?

parts.words: Dealing with those having some complaint?
parts.note: reads like handling customer grievances, but the complaint is an illness and the dealing is medical care

explanation.surface: A customer service desk handles grievances.
explanation.definitionFit: Medical care given to patients with an ailment, and also handling in general.

clue.text: Let off as a result of underworld instruction

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld and a name for that realm
a charge is a formal instruction, such as a judge's to a jury

explanation.surface: A gangster is released on a mobster's orders.
explanation.definitionFit: To discharge a gun is to fire it, and to discharge a prisoner is to release them.

clue.text: Record ring road contention

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: An argument over a road record.
explanation.definitionFit: Discord is strife and disagreement.

clue.text: Cheat having small success led to reform

parts.note: a win is a success

indicators.note: to reform means the letters of the word are formed again in a new order

explanation.surface: A con artist's small victory leads to a change in their ways.
explanation.definitionFit: To swindle is to defraud someone.

clue.text: "X" ages

explanation.surface: A clue that is just a symbol and a word.
explanation.definitionFit: The X sign means multiplied by; long eras are also called the old days.

clue.text: Member of Biblical tribe that doctor got something to eat

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor
a bite is a snack, something to eat

explanation.surface: A doctor in ancient Israel took a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moabites were an ancient people east of the Dead Sea, often mentioned in the Old Testament.

clue.text: Moves on one of family

parts.note: steps are moves, as in dance steps or measures taken

explanation.surface: A family member moves on.
explanation.definitionFit: A stepson is a spouse's son from an earlier relationship, a relative by marriage.

clue.text: Comparatively underhand, that riles badly

indicators.note: badly signals the letters of the next word are jumbled out of order

explanation.surface: More sneaky behaviour annoys people terribly.
explanation.definitionFit: Slier is the comparative of sly, meaning more cunning or devious.

clue.text: Good grounds to set a limit on the beer intake

parts.note: to ration is to restrict the amount allowed
ale is a type of beer

explanation.surface: There is good reason to cut down on drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A rationale is the reasoning or justification behind a decision.

clue.text: A dictator made to measure!

explanation.surface: A tyrant is tailored to fit.
explanation.definitionFit: A sovereign or autocrat governs; a straight-edged stick marked in inches exists for measuring.

clue.text: Taking wrong route is most unusual

indicators.note: wrong signals the letters of the word are in an incorrect order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Going the wrong way is very odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Outré means unconventional, bizarre and eccentric.

clue.text: A service book-could be the third

explanation.surface: A prayer book might be the third in a series.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordinal is a book of church service forms; the word third is also a number showing position.

clue.text: Necessitates salient changes

indicators.note: changes signals the letters of the word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Important changes are required.
explanation.definitionFit: If one thing entails another, it requires it as a consequence.

clue.text: Storage for wardrobe-mistress

explanation.surface: A piece of furniture and a theatre job.
explanation.definitionFit: A dresser is a kitchen cupboard with shelves; in a theatre it is also the person who helps actors with costumes.

clue.text: The control exercised inside

parts.note: to rein in is to control, and a rein is a means of control

explanation.surface: Authority is wielded from within.
explanation.definitionFit: Therein is a formal word meaning in that place, within it.
